authority_basis.summary: Derive or falsify the boundary/metaplectic correction required by the noncircular Mellin-dilation spectral candidate.

operations.title: Pi_0 source symmetry does not supply the missing one-eighth phase
operations.statement: Stirling expansion of the Riemann-Siegel phase contributes -pi/8, changing the raw phase-volume constant 1 to 7/8. Although a symplectic quarter rotation has an order-eight metaplectic lift, the full D4 mapping-class action is trivial on the rank-one component lattice and its dual, hence induces identity in the symplectic group; its metaplectic lifts provide only a central sign. The missing eighth is therefore not derived from pi_0 symmetry.
operations.scope: Exact constant-term and representation-typing audit; does not exclude a higher-rank physical metaplectic correction.

operations.title: Eighth-phase source hostile test
operations.procedure: Compute the Stirling constant in the Riemann-Siegel phase, then evaluate the D4 action on the component generator, group completion, dual lattice, and symplectic double.
operations.expected_result: The smooth constant defect is exactly minus one-eighth, while the induced rank-one symplectic D4 action is trivial. A source quarter rotation on this double would falsify the no-go.
